title: Reactor correctness-first ownership refactor
summary: Complete the 13-task Reactor refactor with one TaskControl and PollLease path, generation/epoch-bearing physical queues, transition-sensitive wake ingress, thread-owned userspace rendezvous, retired compatibility paths, and passive transition counters. Task 13 adds deterministic typed diagnostics and executes every final gate without weakening inherited baselines. Non-goals are txtrace wire/schema/host decoder changes, unrelated baseline cleanup, vendor-image policy changes, and unmeasured wake-ingress sharding or task-table optimization.

write_sets.notes: Isolated codex/reactor-refactor worktree; Task 13 transition diagnostics, focused tests, structural ratchets, and completion records only.

steps.title: Add typed passive transition counters after authoritative transitions
steps.notes: Per-instance Arc ownership allocates only at observer construction. TransitionRecorder is write-only and exposes only unit-returning record methods; the bank and snapshot implementation remain owned by observability.rs, while the crate-private snapshot helper is referenced only by the exact public facade in runtime/diagnostics.rs. Hot recording is an immutable enabled-bit check plus allocation-free lock-free Relaxed fetch_update with saturating_add, so all eleven fields stop at u64::MAX. Reactor and read-only per-thread userspace diagnostics perform independent Relaxed loads and are explicitly non-transactional. ThreadRuntime early owner-token rejection and slot generation mismatch share one per-thread bank and record each StaleRequest outcome exactly once; disabled mode remains zero and ThreadPayload exposes only typed TransitionCounters, never the raw slot. CancelTransition carries lock-protected newly_deferred evidence and only the first cancel_requested false-to-true transition records. Poll acquire validation returns precise stale epoch, hart, and queue-kind reasons under the TaskControl lock; only epoch mismatch records run_token_stale_epoch. No txtrace wire or host surface changed.

steps.title: Prove enabled and disabled modes preserve task behavior
steps.notes: The same self-wake, park, duplicate wake, completion, and terminal-drain script produces identical final TaskStatus, three Future polls, queue depths, completed records, and cancelled records in enabled and disabled modes. Disabled counters remain zero.

steps.title: Pin passive reads and full-tree Reactor structure
steps.notes: The scanner recursively checks every authored crates/tx-reactor/src/**/*.rs and rejects a synthetic 1501-line fixture. The 5364-line runtime/tests.rs moved to runtime/tests/mod.rs and split into eight responsibility modules: affinity_publication 789, queue_publication 1148, wake_and_structure 414, concurrency_unwind 359, lifecycle_terminal 706, generation_tokens 737, acquire_reconciliation 405, and queue_pruning 548 lines; all 93 moved tests remain present. The scheduler fixture now constructs an explicit generation-bearing TaskKey before TaskHandle, and the exact raw-pattern scan is empty. Retired compatibility strings occur only in negative fixtures. Every Reactor source file is at most 1500 lines; scheduler/placement.rs is largest at 1411. The capability ratchet tokenizes comments/literals, preserves raw strings, normalizes ASCII Rust raw identifiers r#ident to logical ident tokens, and scans every production source without recorder gating. It pins all ReactorObservability, TransitionCounters, and snapshot helper references; rejects direct, aliased, wrapper, inline-module, UFCS, raw-identifier, and captured method-item/callback observability routes outside runtime/diagnostics.rs; rejects other transitions/snapshot/counters read calls outside the diagnostic owners; and token-pins the dedicated owner's complete one-method body so an added decision method fails. Raw module paths such as crate::r#observability::TransitionRecorder continue through another :: and remain valid. The module-layout count is 21 and arch lint stays at the inherited 82 findings.

steps.title: Execute host, lint, target, full-build, and smoke gates
steps.notes: All commands were run exactly. Focused/package gates pass except inherited broad tx-subsystems integration visibility/import failures. Existing fmt, arch, unused, docs, progress-reference, and missing vendor-image blockers are recorded below without suppression or ratchet changes. Full-build doctor passes and detects QEMU 10.2.2 plus the RV64 target, but kernel build stops before image/QEMU.
